results.personality_type_description: This determines how we see the world and make decisions.

results.share_encouragement: Share your personality test results with friends and see how your types compare!
results.confidence_description: Our confidence in this result is {confidence}%.

results.too_fast_completion: You completed the test very quickly.
results.trait_I_text: Introverts are most energized when they are alone. They prefer deep, meaningful social interactions and prefer to socialize with a few close friends rather than a large group of people.
results.trait_E_text: Extraverts gain energy from social interaction. They are outgoing and enjoy interacting with a wide variety of people.
results.trait_N_text: Intuitive individuals focus on possibilities and the future. They enjoy thinking abstractly and focus on the big picture rather than the details.
results.trait_S_text: Sensing individuals are practical and focus on facts and details. They prefer hands-on experience rather than theory.
results.trait_T_text: Thinking individuals make decisions based on logic and objective criteria. They prioritize fairness and justice over the feelings of others.
results.trait_F_text: Feeling individuals make decisions based on their values and feelings. They prioritize harmony and cooperation.
results.trait_J_text: Judging individuals are decisive and prefer planning and structure. They enjoy having things organized and like to have things decided.
results.trait_P_text: Prospecting individuals are flexible and prefer to keep their options open. They enjoy spontaneity and enjoy adapting to new situations.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1_text: The Myers-Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI) is an introspective self-report questionnaire indicating differing psychological preferences in how people perceive the world and make decisions. Our test is designed to give you a clear understanding of your personality type based on this model.
faq.q2_text: While no personality test is 100% accurate, our assessment is built on extensive research and designed to be a highly reliable tool for self-discovery. It provides a solid framework for understanding your preferences and how you interact with the world.
faq.q3_title: How long does it take to complete?
faq.q3_text: The test typically takes about 10-15 minutes to complete. We recommend you answer the questions honestly and spontaneously for the most accurate results.
faq.q4_title: Are my test results and profile information private?
faq.q4_text: Yes. Your individual test results are private. Your public profile (name, MBTI, bio, location) is visible to other users on the 'People' page to facilitate community interaction. You can control what information you share on your profile page.
faq.q5_text: The 'People' page is a feature that allows you to connect with other users. You can filter by personality type, location, and other criteria to find and interact with like-minded individuals from around the world.
faq.q6_title: How do I update my profile information?
faq.q6_text: You can update your name, bio, location, and profile picture directly on your profile page. Simply navigate to your profile and click the edit icons next to the information you wish to change.

about.seo_description: Learn about MBTITEST, your destination for an accurate, free 16 personalities test. Discover our mission and unique social features to connect with others based on your MBTI type.
about.title: About MBTITEST: Your Guide to Self-Discovery and Connection
about.intro: Welcome to MBTITEST, the premier destination for anyone looking to explore their personality and connect with others. In a world of fleeting interactions, we believe that understanding yourself is the first step toward building deeper, more meaningful relationships. Our platform is built on this principle, offering one of the most accurate free 16 personalities tests available online.
about.mission_content: Our mission is to provide the most accurate and insightful MBTI personality test to help individuals understand themselves better, discover their potential, and improve their relationships with others.
about.vision_content: We envision a world where everyone can leverage self-awareness to lead a more fulfilling life. We aim to be the most trusted platform for personal growth and interpersonal understanding through psychometric tools.
about.community_intro: mbti16personalities.online is more than just a test; it's a platform for connection and self-discovery. We offer several features to support your journey:
about.feature1_description: Search and filter for people who share your personality type, or explore types you're curious about, both locally and globally.
about.feature2_description: Discover how your personality type interacts with others in friendships, romance, and the workplace. Our insights can help you navigate your social world with greater confidence.
about.feature3_description: Connect with like-minded individuals, find friends, and understand your compatibility with others based on personality types.
about.community_conclusion: We are committed to creating a supportive and insightful community for everyone interested in personal development.
about.team_content: Our team is composed of psychology enthusiasts, data scientists, and developers passionate about helping people unlock their potential. We are dedicated to maintaining the scientific validity of our test and continuously improving the user experience on our platform.
about.journey_content: Whether you are new to personality theories or a seasoned enthusiast, we invite you to take our test, explore your type, and connect with our community. Your journey of self-discovery starts here.
